answer.rationale: Activation messaging (memory_91) and onboarding simplification (memory_31) have both demonstrated durable improvements to early engagement without retention risk. Current activation decline of 6% QoQ directly mirrors the problem these approaches solved. Memory_91 showed improved week-one engagement; memory_31 showed sustained activation lift. These are lower-risk, proven levers for the stated activation problem. Promotional_pricing is ruled out due to memory_73's clear retention damage (-12%, no renewal). Referral_incentive (memory_57) works but requires established customer base—less helpful for new activation crisis. Enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) addresses a different funnel stage and doesn't address the immediate activation decline. Activation messaging offers direct applicability to the current metric decline, leverages validated learning, and avoids the revenue-quality erosion seen in discounting. Standard experiment scope allows safe validation of whether activation messaging remains effective in current cohort conditions.
